pattern.description: The centered two-line title glides to the left third as a Slack channel-selection dialog slides in from the right edge; a cursor then enters and ticks the first channel checkbox, turning the title card into a split title-plus-demo layout.
pattern.why_premium: The title is never dismissed: it makes room for the product UI in one shared move, so the viewer keeps the headline while the demo starts, and the cursor action begins as soon as the panel settles with no dead frames.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(titleLines, {x: -leftShift, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.inOut'}).fromTo(dialog, {x: 420, opacity: 0}, {x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<').fromTo(cursor, {x: -120, y: 60}, {x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '-=0.15').set(checkbox, {className: '+=checked'}).
build_hint.remotion: p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120}}) (no overshoot); title translateX = -leftShift * p; dialog translateX = 420 * (1 - p), opacity = p; cursor path interpolated with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad) starting ~5 frames later; checkbox state flips on the click frame.

notes: cursor_guided_demo is a reasonable secondary pattern (cursor ticks all-company at the end). camera.move none: the large pan_x is the title/dialog content moving, not a camera pan. Manual boxes used for dialog, cursor and checkbox. No SFX candidates.
